scenes.say: Flexbox is everywhere in modern web layouts. Why do interviewers care, and how does it make layouts easier?

scenes.label: Model
scenes.sub: Distributes space along one axis—row or column.
scenes.say: Flexbox is a one-dimensional layout model. It distributes space along a single axis, either row or column.
Here's a Flexbox setup. The container uses display flex, then aligns and spaces items with justify content and align items.
Use Flexbox for one-direction layouts, like navigation bars. Use Grid for two-dimensional layouts, like dashboards.

scenes.question: What does display: flex do?
scenes.right: It turns an element into a flex container, so its children use the flexbox model for layout.
scenes.say: Don't confuse display flex with automatic alignment. It makes the container flexible, so its children can use Flexbox properties.
